judul: Gari Tsutomu-kun to Uraaka-san – Sanzan Osewa ni Natteiru Ero-kei Uraaka Joshi no Shoutai ga Kurasu no Idol Datta Ken
Author: Suzuki Enpera, Hanasaki Mahiru
synopsis: Want to Peek at the Erotic “Other Side” of the Class Idol? Bookworm high school student Gari Tsutomu’s secret hobby is scouring erotic “裏垢” (uraka – hidden/alt accounts) on social media. Tsutomu, who especially worships a big-breasted high school girl on a hidden account named “RIKA” like a goddess, diligently collects the erotic photos she uploads daily. One day, Tsutomu saves the “perfect beautiful girl” in Staff Room, Tachibana Marika, from a pinch, and by chance learns her “secret”. For some reason, she then suddenly gets close to Tsutomu and starts revealing a side of herself she shows no one else–!?
